text:
Noah (Growth): flagging an oddity in the weekly KPI deck: paid MQLs down 19% but paid clicks steady. dropping here for quick triage. :thinking_face:
Tara (Analytics): digging in. initial filter by campaign shows some conversions grouped under (unknown). suspect redirector trimming utm_campaign on some clickpaths.
Sam (MarOps): I rotated campaign canonicalization rules last Monday but only for syndicated partners. Could be collateral.
Luis (Product Marketing): we ran a small headline variant on organic only. paid creative unchanged per creative-registry.
Tara (Analytics): quick check SQL I ran:
```
SELECT coalesce(utm_campaign,'(missing)') c, count(*) convs
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY convs DESC LIMIT 8;
```
Tara (Analytics): seeing a bump in (missing) correlated with referer host adrelay.testpartner.com
Sam (MarOps): that matches an open ticket with TestPartner (TP-221). they're testing a new redirect chain. I'll escalate and ask for a rollback on the test traffic.
Noah (Growth): for Friday KPI email we need not to undercount paid. can BI add a heuristic fallback for attribution (referer host -> mapped campaign) so numbers are stable for the send?
Tara (Analytics): yes. I'll add heuristic_campaign in the ETL: utm_campaign -> session last-known campaign -> referer-domain map. low risk. ETA ~30m to push to BI.
-dash-bot: dashboard "weekly_launch_metrics" updated by Tara. https://bi.redwood/d/weekly_launch_metrics
Noah (Growth): great. once landed re-run the WoW and I'll update the KPI email with a short note: "Attribution adjustments in progress."
Sam (MarOps): adding server-side hidden_campaign token to registration backlog to prevent client-side losses next push. low lift.
Luis (Product Marketing): agree on hidden token. also adding a tiny sanity viz to the dashboard showing percent of conversions in (missing) over time. helps future triage.
Tara (Analytics): posting interim numbers when ETL completes.
Noah (Growth): thanks team :thumbsup:
